title: Equal scalar-defect classes imply Brauer equivalence
statement: If scalar-defect realizations of two central simple algebras have equal cohomology classes, the algebras are Brauer equivalent.

source.place: The scalar-defect construction following Lemma 03R6, Theorem 03R7, and Section 0DVG

proof.text: Apply tensor_opposite_split_of_brauerScalarDefect_eq to obtain a positive n and an actual splitting eAB : A⊗Bop ≅ M_n(K).

Put m=dim_K B, which is positive since B is a nonzero finite-dimensional K-algebra. Apply bijectivity of the canonical enveloping map for B, form its uniquely determined inverse, and express End_K(B) in the finite basis Module.finBasis K B. Tensor commutation gives eBB : Bop⊗B ≅ M_m(K).

Compose matrixEquivTensor, tensor congruences, the inverse tensor associator and tensor commutation to obtain M_m(A) ≅ A⊗M_m(K) ≅ A⊗(Bop⊗B) ≅ (A⊗Bop)⊗B ≅ M_n(K)⊗B ≅ M_n(B). The witnesses m,n and their nonvanishing prove IsBrauerEquivalent A B by its definition.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03R7 and 074I: tensor comparison and explicit matrix amplification
